union_merge.method: additive union of all historical versions of this file (548 versions / 60 commits / all refs) over current main; identity = canonical input (entry.input, else key); main preserved verbatim, main wins contested inputs (PR #357 precedent)
union_merge.era_note: final set era census: T8/WH-newest=7, T3=107; additions selected newest-era first (T8/T7/TTT2/T6+other teardowns), T3 payloads used only where no newer expression exists; union-first, no-loss absolute

merge_sources.note: Existing moves untouched. New moves carry merge_source; slots = default input map (editor can reassign any move). Damage scaled to WH 100 HP, raw in damage_raw.
